description: Stuff in the garage? Boxes in the closet? Storage unit you haven't opened in two years? Snap & Store captures what's in every box and uses AI to catalog it, so anything you've stored is one search away. 1. Stick a Snap & Store QR label on your box. 2. Capture photos and video of what's going in, narrating if you want. 3. The AI catalogs the items, each with its own photo. You review, tweak, done. Need something later? Search for any item and Snap & Store tells you exactly which box it's in. Walk
